}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "MPi M28K v1.1" and "MANGOPI" are silkscreened on the board top.
===Specifications=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3528 @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Storage: TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card :eMMC module connector *Memory: 2GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800 D80 (1T1R 802.11ax) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi, UART/PCM: BT 5.4 BLE *USB: 2x USB 2.0 port *Network: 2x 1GbE ports *Power Source: 5-12V via USB Type-C (supports PD)
